**I’d choose the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus with the 220W solar panel** for car camping. The station has about 1,024Wh of capacity, and the guide ranks it best overall among its camping picks; the panel-bundled version is also specifically listed as a product package. It weighs roughly 28 lb, so it’s better for car camping than for carrying far from the trailhead. ([camping comparison](https://smartenergyedge.com/best-portable-power-station-with-solar-panels-for-camping/), [panel bundle listing](https://nymag.com/strategist/article/best-emergency-preparedness-items-for-first-time-homeowners.html))
